general.openAtLoginDesc: Runs in the menu bar only, so connection requests can be approved right away.
general.openAtLoginDesc_win: Runs in the notification area only, so connection requests can be approved right away.
general.loginItemsApproval: Also allow it in System Settings › Login Items.
general.loginItemsApproval_win: Also turn it on in Settings › Apps › Startup.
general.connectionRequestsDesc: Always on, as they need your approval
general.agentQuestionsDesc: Expire after 30 minutes if no one answers
general.menuBadge: Show a dot on the icon when something needs you

update.title: Updates
update.autoDownloadDesc: Once downloaded, they install when Aide quits or restarts

account.removeDeviceMessage: This device will lose approval permissions immediately, and its machine will be removed too. Any machines and personal agents it approved will be re-signed by this Mac and continue working (requires Touch ID).
account.removeDeviceMessage_win: This device will lose approval permissions immediately, and its machine will be removed too. Any machines and personal agents it approved will be re-signed by this PC and continue working (requires Windows Hello).
account.signOutRemovedMessage: This Mac is no longer in your Aide account and can’t approve requests. After signing out, you can set it up again or rejoin your account.
account.signOutRemovedMessage_win: This PC is no longer in your Aide account and can’t approve requests. After signing out, you can set it up again or rejoin your account.
account.signOutFirstMessage: This device is still one of your trusted devices. First, remove it from another trusted device under Settings › Account & Devices so its approval rights are revoked and its machine disconnects. Then sign out here.
account.elevatesSilently: On this PC, User Account Control is off or set to Never notify, allowing any program to gain administrator privileges without asking and approve requests on your behalf.
account.unlockHelloDesc: Each approval on this PC is confirmed with Windows Hello.
account.unlockPassphraseDesc: Each approval on this PC is confirmed with your passphrase, typed in the signer’s window.
account.passphraseRisk: Less safe than Windows Hello: a program running as you could in theory steal your passphrase (a look-alike window, a key logger) or guess it, so the promise that agents on this PC can’t approve on their own is weaker than with Windows Hello.
account.usePassphraseTitle: Use a Passphrase Instead of Windows Hello?
account.usePassphraseMessage: Windows asks for permission, then Aide’s signer asks you, in its own window, to choose a passphrase and to confirm once with Windows Hello. You can switch back at any time.
account.devicesNote: Every trusted device can approve connection requests. If a device is lost, remove it from another trusted device.
account.machineOnlyNote: This Mac is an execution machine in your account: it runs agent tasks and is configured here, but it cannot approve requests or see your other machines. Use a trusted device to approve requests.
account.machineOnlyNote_win: This PC is an execution machine in your account: it runs agent tasks and is configured here, but it cannot approve requests or see your other machines. Use a trusted device to approve requests.

password.title: Account and password
password.offDesc: When on, a new phone or computer logs in with the account and password alone: nothing to approve here, no digits to compare.
password.onDesc: On a new device, type the server {{server}}, the account and the password.
password.turnOnNote: At least 8 characters. Saving asks you to confirm once (Touch ID / Windows Hello).
password.changeNote: Changing it signs out every device and agent that logged in with the old password.
password.saved: Logging in with a password is on
password.changed_one: Password changed; {{count}} device that logged in with the old one is signed out
password.changed_other: Password changed; {{count}} devices that logged in with the old one are signed out
password.offTitle: Turn Off Logging In with a Password?
password.offMessage: Nobody can log in with the account and password any more, and every device and agent that did is signed out. Devices that joined with an approval stay.
password.offDone: Logging in with a password is off

grants.note: Access controls which projects, machines, and coding agents an agent can use, and for how long.
grants.disconnectMessage: It will lose access immediately. Any running tasks will be interrupted, while task history is preserved. Reconnect it if you want to use it again.
grants.disconnectedOffline: Disconnected “{{name}}”; {{machines}} offline, will take effect once back online
grants.execDesc: Lets it run shell commands directly on these machines, for operations. Every call, refused ones too, is in the Ops Log. Off unless you turn it on.
grants.allMachinesLater: All machines (including ones that join later)
grants.renameMessage: Shown here and on your other devices. Other agents only see the name.
grants.iconAutoHint: Matches its name or where it signs in (for example, a connection from cursor.com appears as Cursor).
grants.iconBad: Couldn’t read that image. Try a PNG or JPEG.

ops.none: No agent has run a command yet.
ops.unreachable: Not listed: {{machines}} can’t be reached now.
ops.note: The commands agents ran on your machines with Run commands (Access), and those refused. Each machine keeps its last 500; their output is kept nowhere.

machines.deviceNote: This machine is your trusted device “{{name}}”. To remove it, go to <go>Account & Devices</go>.
machines.shareDesc: Aide runs them from the command line just as you do, without reading API keys or tokens. Turning this off stops active tasks here; turning it on requires Touch ID.
machines.shareDesc_win: Aide runs them from the command line just as you do, without reading API keys or tokens. Turning this off stops active tasks here; turning it on requires Windows Hello.
machines.renameMessage: Agents refer to projects as “machine/project”, so renaming updates how they address this machine. Use only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).
machines.nameUnusable: This name has no letter or digit. Machine names use only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).
machines.removeMessage: This machine will disconnect immediately and any running tasks will stop. It will need to pair again to rejoin.
machines.offlineAgents: Machine is offline; agents will appear once it reconnects
machines.herDesc: Her’s assistants, conversations and settings live on this machine. Turning Her off asks whether to keep them for next time or erase them. Turning it on or off requires Touch ID.
machines.herDesc_win: Her’s assistants, conversations and settings live on this machine. Turning Her off asks whether to keep them for next time or erase them. Turning it on or off requires Windows Hello.
machines.herWindows: Update Aide on this PC to run Her.
machines.herNeedsUpdate: Aide on this computer is older. Update it there to run Her.
machines.herKept: Her’s data is still on this machine; turned on again, she carries on.
machines.herEraseMessage: Her’s assistants, conversations, memory, routines, files, connectors and model logins on “{{name}}” are deleted. This can’t be undone.

wake.title: Wake on New Messages
wake.note: Aide calls its routine to wake it when a task it started finishes or another agent writes to it. For another bot on this connection, ask that bot.
